# Tilak Joshi — Portfolio

> Full-Stack Engineer building SaaS and business integrations.
> SAP Business One · Web Applications · API Integrations · DevOps

## About

Tilak Joshi is a full-stack engineer based in Bhimdatta, Kanchanpur, Nepal.
He builds business software end to end — from React and Next.js interfaces to
Node.js APIs, databases, deployment pipelines, and SAP Business One add-ons and
integrations.

Email: t.joshi.dev@gmail.com

## Experience

- Senior MERN Stack Developer — Bizhub Consulting Service, Lalitpur, Nepal (Dec 2023 – Present)
- Full Stack Developer (Part-time, Hybrid) — Global Dairy, Kathmandu, Nepal (Aug 2025 – Present)
- Web Developer — Neem Infosys, Mahendranagar, Nepal (Apr 2022 – Oct 2023)

Education: BSc. Computer Science & IT, Siddhanath Science Campus, Tribhuvan University (2019 – 2023).

- DevOps and Infrastructure: Docker, Docker Compose, Portainer, Nginx, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Git, Linux, Windows Server, SSH, process management, backup and restore
- AI and Current Learning: Gemini API, Qdrant, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation (learning/exploration, not model training)
